displayName: OCI-WSTG10-005: Error Handling — Verbose Error Information Disclosure
description:
Detects verbose error responses containing stack traces, database details, or internal paths

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

conditions.value: error handling — verbose error information disclos

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg10_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%error%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%handling%') AND "value" > 0
